goal: Harden post-Baseline governance and add a bounded parallel-workstream control plane without changing Architecture Baseline v1 semantics.
baseline_impact: none; guard implementation and post-Baseline development coordination only
acceptance: Baseline schema_through remains the immutable migration ceiling at the Baseline tag and later L1/L2 migrations do not invalidate v1.
Change Contract intent_id must equal the referenced live capability-admission intent_id so stale L3 authorization cannot carry across tasks.
L3 protected semantic changes require ADR/counterexample/affected-invariant/compatibility metadata and an approval reference before the gate permits protected changes.
Parallel industry/product Agents can use independent workstream cursors and write scopes without mutating one global current cursor, admission or Change Contract.
Capability Registry remains the sole stable semantic-owner registry and Architecture Baseline v1 invariants remain unchanged.
